title: MusicDrop v1.3.5 Available
changelog:
• Master 9-Tab Swipeable Hub: Home, Songs, Playlists, Download, Device, Albums, Artists, Genres, Folders with smooth horizontal swipe navigation
• Minimal Edge-to-Edge Experience: Bottom navigation bar hidden by default with edge-to-edge footer player, toggleable in Settings
• Modern Music Player Overhaul: Centered Song / Lyrics toggle, 8 dynamic themes & blurred ambient backgrounds
• Floating Pill Seekbar: Progress slider with centered [ 1:40 / 2:10 ] badge and +/-10s seek buttons
• 5-Icon Utility Row: Favorite heart, Add to Playlist, Hardware Equalizer with ON indicator, Sleep Timer, and Queue sheet
• Audio Equalizer & Bass Boost: Real hardware-accelerated 5-band audio equalizer, bass boost, and surround virtualizer with audio presets
• Synchronized Lyrics: Auto-scrolling and interactive tap-to-seek lyrics view
